summary: Clicking your own Imperial Favor while its Battle action (send an enemy attacker home) is offered starts that action's target step at once: click the attacker on the table or pick it from the sidebar list. Cancel action deselects the Favor; it returns to the Favor's pane only if the pane offers another Favor action, which never happens in battle (the other two are Limited). Kyuden Otomo's Favor token is a cost choice inside the same draft, so nothing is lost. Cards that discard the Favor as their own cost are played from those cards and are unaffected.
validation: tools/check-persistent-home.sh PERSISTENT_HOME_PASS at 1920x1080 and 1440x900, twice (one earlier 1440x900 run hit a Favor-hover timing flake in the Action-phase section; main and two reruns passed). New probe steps: battle click starts favor-battle with a visible target list, Cancel deselects, a second click restarts it, then the action executes; Kyuden Otomo token case keeps the cost choice and Cancel deselects. Screenshots reviewed.
